question: Which of the following 'V' blocks will have a 'V' notch and two slots on either side for clamping in two positions?
solution:
The correct answer is __Single level double groove 'V' block**(Option 2)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Single level double groove 'V' block__ features a 'V' notch with two slots on either side.
 
• The design of the double groove allows clamping in two positions.
 
• It is primarily used for precision machining and holding cylindrical objects.
 
• Provides enhanced stability and versatility in operations.
 
• Commonly used in industrial and mechanical applications.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Single level single groove 'V' block:**

 
 
• Features one groove and is used for simpler clamping tasks.
 
• Not designed for clamping in multiple positions.
 
 
 
• **Matched pair 'V' block: **
 
 
• Comes as a set of two blocks for simultaneous use.
 
• Provides greater accuracy for precision tasks.
 
 
 
• **Double level single groove 'V' block:**
 
 
• Features grooves at two different levels for more flexible operations.
 
• Typically used for holding objects at varying heights.
